name: An Afternoon in Nyack 2024

venue.name: [Palisades Center](https://www.palisadescenter.com/)
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

information:
This competition is a fundraiser for Sunrise Amherst & Glow Cultural center (Please see the Fundraiser tab for the web link)

Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest during the competition.
The Harry & Thelma Adler community room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.
